title: Speldosa
linked_hint: A tag plays the same on every box in the home
new_tag_text: Tag {tag} has no music yet. Leave it on the box and pick what it should play.
link_new_hint: Put it on any box first
no_tag_on_box: No new tag is on a box. Put the tag on a box, then select Link a new tag again.
no_box: No Speldosa box is set up yet. Add one under Settings, Devices and services, Add integration, Speldosa.
unlink_confirm: Unlink {name}? The tag stays, it just plays nothing until you link it again.
reader_problem: Reader problem: unplug the box for a few seconds
search_hint: Searches your Music Assistant library and its services, such as Spotify
empty: Nothing came back. If you expected results, Spotify may be busy: try again in half a minute.
weaker_hint: Results that match only some of the words
pick_first: Pick what the tag should play
mode_random_episode_hint: Plays one whole episode. Every chosen episode is heard once before any repeats.
window_hint: Put back within the box's resume window, a tag always continues where it was.
mode_random_album_hint: For audiobook series where each album is one episode, such as Die drei ??? or Bamse. Plays one whole album, in order. Every chosen album is heard once before any repeats.
mode_next_album_hint: Plays the chosen albums one after another, in episode-number order.
mode_next_episode_hint: Plays the episodes one after another, in order.
series_hint: Lifted halfway, the tag continues there when it comes back, however much later. It moves on only when the album has been heard to the end.
albums_none: No albums found. Until the list loads, the tag shuffles the artist.
